data_flow: Securing research-grade GPUs required enduring long approval queues, forcing the lean engineering team to rely on consumer-grade hardware. This created major latency bottlenecks and challenging generation queues. The team had to manually over-provision their architecture to survive unpredictable traffic spikes. This defensive strategy burned through two to three times their current server budget and diverted critical engineering focus away from product development.
business_outcome: Maintains 99.9% AI pipeline availability on Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform; Lowers asynchronous inference costs by ~30% using Batch inference; Eliminates manual over-provisioning to reduce server budgets by up to 3x; Catches API key anomalies instantly, leveraging Cloud Billing outlier alerts
